set.q: Choose the best answer: How long ___ for the bus so far? It is already getting dark.
set.why: 지금까지 계속된 동작의 기간을 물을 때는 현재완료진행 have you been waiting을 써요.

patches.why: Remove defensible 'will you wait'/'do you wait' readings; 'so far' pins present perfect progressive.

set.q: Which time expression usually goes with the past simple, not the present perfect?
set.why: ago는 과거의 한 시점을 나타내므로 과거시제와 쓰고, so far, up to now, in recent weeks는 현재완료와 잘 어울려요.

set.q: Which expression can follow 'since' in the sentence "She has been absent since ___"?
